concept.title: On the SMS mobile app
concept.shortdesc: To view status of motor components:

conbody.p: To view status of motor components:

ol.li: Log in to the SMS mobile application.

li.p: Tap Motors on the bottom menu.

ol.li: Select the corresponding location associated with the motor.

li.p: From the subsequent screens, select the corresponding plant, process, and motor name.
The motor’s information page is displayed. The Motor Status tab is displayed by default.
Figure Motor Status tab on the SMS mobile app

ol.li: Scroll up to view all the components and monitor their status.
